title: A world monster's life and behaviour loop (_tickMonsters)
oneLine: Each monster's alive/respawn, resolver phases, ball in flight, sticky aggro, chase, wind-ups, leash and wander, ticked per zone.
topConcern: A ball in the air when its thrower dies is never cleared, so it lands from the previous life on the first tick after respawn.

title: A player's death and respawn (dying, dead, respawnAt, the owed respawn)
oneLine: Alive, dying for 5 s, respawned in town; the phone's death screen, its watchdog and the owed-respawn replay.
topConcern: Monster aggro, PvP targeting and NML skip players on ps.dead, which the phone writes on every move: a modified phone is untouchable.

title: A game socket's life on the worker (open, joined, closed) and its close codes
oneLine: Session from upgrade through pre-join, joining, joined, AFK, flood, takeover and close; the tick loop it keeps alive.
topConcern: A join that throws closes with 4010, the linger's code, so the phone shows the linger countdown and retries every 5 s forever.

title: The body left in a fight (linger)
oneLine: A leaver's body stays 20 s after a PvP hit; a near rejoin resumes it, any other join waits.
topConcern: A same-id takeover (second tab, quick relaunch) skips the linger and reloads HP up to 10 s stale: an escape plus a heal.

title: The world map's watch on far players (presence v2)
oneLine: A per-session 8 s lease renewed by the open map, a fresh-send flag, and a 30 s online list.

title: The HTTP economy token (one per live session)
oneLine: Token minted at join, enforced or legacy, valid only while the session lives.
topConcern: Between setting session.id and minting the token a header-less request passes as legacy; only storage awaits sit there today.

title: A bundle's parts, one after another (the quiet phone)
oneLine: An array frame cut to 24 non-join parts, each awaited in order with the session re-read.

title: The AFK clock (what counts as input)
oneLine: lastRecv stamped by real input only; 120 s idle closes 4006 and the phone waits for a touch.

title: A pile of loot on the ground (kill piles, death piles, drops)
oneLine: Four claim lanes, owner and free windows, private minute, expiry and despawn on one in-memory pile.
topConcern: Every pile, including a death pile holding a whole bag, is lost on a room restart (documented and accepted).

title: A player's shield: raised, parry window, held, broken
oneLine: Blocking from the phone's moves, a 250 ms parry window on each raise, hold drain, a 3 s guard-break latch.
topConcern: Nothing separates two raises, so a phone dropping the shield for one move every ~240 ms parries every blow it blocks.

title: A phone's relay to the room (allowlist, budget, rebuild, intercepts)
oneLine: Privileged drop, allowlist, social lane or bucket, rebuild in the sender's name, handshake intercepts, fan-out.
topConcern: A peer's corpse is set and cleared only by the dying phone's relays; a respawn while its tab sleeps leaves a corpse on every screen.

title: "In a fight or not" and the pools' regen (with its paced save)
oneLine: Two combat stamps read by seven different windows; regen modes; coalesced pool saves flushed on close.
topConcern: Seven unnamed fight windows in seven files; index.js:3640 computes one never read.

title: The PvP consent pairs (duel, arena, threat)
oneLine: A pair map of until-stamps written by duel, arena and threat, read by six identical checks.
topConcern: Lapsed pairs linger until death or disconnect; _pvpChallenges is walked but never written.

title: Memory savers turned off for every phone (client_off)
oneLine: Live off_ flags sent as one list at join and on every change; the phone keeps the last word.

title: A copy's page refused (the origin lock)
oneLine: Stateless origin check; one refusal message and close 4015; the phone shows the origin screen and stops.

title: The leaderboard report's throttle
oneLine: Per-session clock and signature, stamped before the cross-object fetch, forced at join.

title: The round-trip measurement (ping and pong)
oneLine: Ping every ~3 s; only the latest ping's pong is a sample, held time removed, smoothed and capped.
topConcern: A phone answering after the next ping never samples, so the PvP rewind keeps a stale RTT.

title: What a paid ability opens (ability_use: the roll, the special, the retreat)
oneLine: Pool charged, then a 1 s roll window, special windows or retreat shots that later hits read.
topConcern: ability_use refuses dying but not the parry stagger every sibling handler refuses, so a staggered player still buys dodge i-frames.
